notes:
- Capes has its own page in the sidebar: tools down the left, the canvas in the middle, frames underneath, the player wearing it and the colours on the right.
- My capes keeps every cape you save. Open one to edit it, wear it, copy it or delete it, and the rest stay where they are.
- Saved capes open again. A big animated cape was shrunk while loading and came back as an empty new one.
- Zoom the canvas with the buttons or Ctrl and the mouse wheel. Fit puts the whole cape in view, and a pixel grid shows up once pixels are big enough.
- Detail sets how many pixels the texture has, from 64 to 1024. The cape in game stays the same size, it just gets finer.
- Keys in the studio: B brush, F fill, L line, R box, I pick colour, M mirror, G grid, X swap colours, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+S.
- Drop a picture anywhere on the Capes page to upload it.
